name: Majuu Hunter Leia
source:
In the small republic of Haam monsters and people live in sequestered parts of the capitol city.
No one dares go to the district of Demonei. No one but the Demon Hunters.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ130279.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在小小的共和国Haam，怪物与人类分居在首都的不同区域。没人敢踏入Demonei区，除了魔物猎人。
